# Computer Science Circles

> Free, interactive Python programming lessons and tools for beginners, created by the University of Waterloo's CEMC.

CS Circles provides a comprehensive introduction to Python programming through structured lessons, interactive exercises, and browser-based tools. The curriculum progresses from variables and functions through control flow and program design, with integrated visualization and debugging support.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- Variables and data types
- Functions and arguments
- Control flow (if statements)
- User input and output
- Debugging and errors
- Comments and strings
- Type conversion
- Program design
- Beginner tutorials
- Interactive coding
- Code visualization
- Logic errors
- Syntax errors

## Interactive Tools

- [Console](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/console): Browser-based Python interpreter for testing and running code online.
- [Online Python Tutor - Visualize program execution](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/visualize): Python code visualizer for understanding program execution and debugging.

## Structured Lessons

- [1: Variables](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/1-variables): Lesson 1: Introduction to Python variables and data storage fundamentals.
- [2: Functions](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/2-functions): Lesson 2: Functions, arguments, return values, and built-in functions.
- [3: Comments and Quotes](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/3-comments-literals): Lesson 3: Comments, strings, and escape sequences in Python.
- [4: Types](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/4-types): Lesson 4: Data types, type system, and type conversion in Python.
- [5: Input](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/5-input): Lesson 5: User input function and input/output in Python.
- [6: If](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/6-if): Lesson 6: If statements, conditional logic, and control flow in Python.
- [7: Rich Editor](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/7-rich-editor): Lesson 7: Introduction to the rich code editor with syntax highlighting.

## Supplementary Lessons & Practice

- [1E: Errors](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/1e-errors): Lesson 1E: Understanding syntax, runtime, and logic errors in Python.
- [2X: Extra Practice](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/2x-extra-practice): Lesson 2X: Extra coding exercises for functions and debugging practice.
- [6D: Design, Debugging and Donuts](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/6d-design): Lesson 6D: Program design, debugging techniques, and problem-solving.

## Getting Started & Reference

- [Computer Science Circles](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca): Homepage for CS Circles, beginner Python programming from University of Waterloo.
- [Using This Website](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/using-this-website): Getting started guide for using CS Circles interactive Python lessons and exercises.
- [Cheatsheet](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/cheatsheet): Quick reference guide for Python syntax, operators, and control flow.
- [Run Python At Home](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/run-at-home): Guide to installing Python locally and setting up development environment.
- [Resources](https://cscircles.cemc.uwaterloo.ca/resources): Curated learning resources for Python, algorithms, and next steps after basics.
